description: This file defines the Android Activity 'ProductListActivity' which manages the display, filtering, and grouping of product listings within an online shopping app. It handles UI setup, user interactions, filtering, preset management, dynamic loading sections, and integrates with ViewModels for data flow related to product categories, queries, filters, and orders.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: Main Android activity managing the product listing interface with filtering, grouping, preset management, and dynamic content loading.

methods.name: setupCategoryChipsAndGrouping
methods.description: Sets up the category chips UI and handles the logic for rendering and interaction, including observing category list, selection, and rebuilding grouped sections.

methods.name: toggleGroupedMode
methods.description: Toggles between grouped and paged list view based on category selection.

methods.name: renderCategoryChips
methods.description: Renders category selection chips dynamically, including an 'All' option, and handles user selection.

methods.name: rebuildGroupedSections
methods.description: Builds the grouped category sections view, including lazy-loading previews when sections are scrolled into view.

methods.name: maybeLoadSectionIfVisible
methods.description: Checks if a section is visible and if so, loads its preview data.

methods.name: loadSectionPreview
methods.description: Fetches and displays a preview of products for a specific category section.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures subtle animations for the RecyclerView items.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Configures buttons for clearing filters, saving, and applying presets.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Initializes search input, filter chips, and their interactions, updating ViewModel state.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Synchronizes UI filter controls to match ViewModel filter state, especially when applying presets.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays active filters and search query as removable chips allowing users to clear individual filters.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays dialog for saving current filters as a preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Displays list of saved presets for the user to apply or delete.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Shows options to apply or delete a selected preset.

methods.name: confirmDeletePreset
methods.description: Asks user for confirmation before deleting a preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Updates the empty state message based on current search/filter status.
